scope: Per-family observable behavior cases plus complete support-entry inventory; not an exhaustive cross-product of every HTML attribute, optional prop, and browser.

notes: 40 common event names use synthetic dispatch to verify JSON transport; each family separately exercises actual native interactions.
Common attributes verify update/removal and DOM identity on Input, not all inherited HTML attributes on every part.
35 native-context-only parts retain their existing RawComposition browser test; they are not claimed as JSON adapters.

testNames: audit/accordion: single and multiple panels honor keyboard and external selection
audit/alert: destructive presentation and nested action
notApplicable: Root itself is a live region

testNames: audit/alert-dialog: controlled modal and keyboard dismissal
stateTransitions: Trigger opens, Escape closes, host writes true, explicit dismissal closes
keyboard: Enter trigger, Escape dismissal and trigger focus restoration
Tab wraps and skips disabled button
limitations: Outside interaction policies and visual animation

testNames: audit/aspect-ratio: child layout follows reactive ratio
stateTransitions: 2 → 1 changes the height at fixed width
notApplicable: Layout wrapper has no native event or keyboard action

testNames: audit/attachment: terminal presentation and separate child trigger and action
stateTransitions: uploading → processing → error → done → idle updates data-state

testNames: audit/avatar: source loading, failure and recovery drive fallback
stateTransitions: valid image → invalid image → valid image
Explicitly loaded avatar preserves preload bypass and emits no status event when src changes
notApplicable: Avatar image and fallback are display-only

testNames: audit/badge: span becomes a keyboard-activated link
nesting: Badge default slot renders Typography in place of fallback

testNames: audit/breadcrumb: current page, link activation, and hidden separators
nesting: List/Item with current page, link, separators and ellipsis
keyboard: Tab reaches only navigable link; Enter activates and updates URL hash
notApplicable: Navigation reflects host-provided current item
limitations: Ellipsis menus and link custom child

testNames: audit/bubble: content and reactions follow variant and alignment
nesting: Group → Root → Content and Reactions → Button
notApplicable: Root itself has no native control

testNames: audit/button: native keyboard activation and disabled host control
inputs: Disabled href variant removes href, uses aria-disabled and tabindex=-1
events: click and keyDown including key payload
Physical click on disabled href variant leaves direct and ancestor Action State unchanged
nesting: Typography default child takes precedence over fallback text
keyboard: Tab skips disabled button; Enter/Space on button; Enter on link
notApplicable: No component-managed selected/open state

testNames: audit/button-group: orientation and nested button tab order
nesting: Nested horizontal group inside outer group with text/separator
keyboard: Tab skips disabled child and preserves native order; Space activates child
notApplicable: Group does not implement composite roving focus or selection
limitations: Visual borders and mixed input/button layout

testNames: audit/calendar: date codec, keyboard day navigation, limits and null reset
audit/calendar: multiple dates round-trip as ISO arrays
stateTransitions: 2026-11-02 → 2026-11-03 → user deselect null → external 2026-11-05 → external null
multiple [02] → [02,05] → third day resets to [06] → external []
nesting: Internal calendar grid and day composition
notApplicable: Calendar parts require native scoped snippets

testNames: audit/card: compact layout retains header, content, footer and actions
notApplicable: Card itself has no native control

testNames: audit/carousel: arrows and nested controls navigate to bounded slide positions
stateTransitions: external horizontal → vertical reorients track and next moves on Y axis
notApplicable: Embla position and opts have no JSON State input

testNames: audit/chart: SVG kinds, series replacement and empty, null, invalid data
stateTransitions: Chart.Container config updates computed CSS variable
notApplicable: JSON recipe has no keyboard operation or callback
limitations: Native tooltip rendering and pointer hover

supportEntries.limitation: Requires scoped native Calendar or LayerChart context; use the components namespace in host Svelte composition.

testNames: audit/checkbox: Space emits boolean and controlled disabled blocks changes
keyboard: Space checks and clears mixed state

testNames: audit/code-block: numbered and slotted lines, updated keyboard copy
stateTransitions: code changes update displayed lines and clipboard

testNames: audit/collapsible: keyboard opens and external close hides nested action
keyboard: Enter on disabled trigger leaves open false

testNames: audit/combobox: search, keyboard choice, and external reset update the trigger
keyboard: ArrowDown and Enter choose filtered option
notApplicable: Composite does not expose arbitrary option slots

testNames: audit/command: filtering, disabled selection, and dialog State
stateTransitions: Host opens palette; Down highlights Save; keyword and empty results; Escape closes
Unrelated summary State write preserves input DOM identity, focus, and draft
keyboard: ArrowDown skips disabled; Enter selects; Escape closes
limitations: Columns, link item, and Vim bindings

testNames: audit/context-menu: disabled items, radio State, and keyboard submenu
stateTransitions: Host writes radio selection; one keyboard choice changes State while menu stays open, then a second choice commits selection and closes
nesting: Group, RadioGroup and Sub with independent submenu content under portalled menu
keyboard: ArrowDown skips disabled item; e typeahead; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft enters/leaves submenu; Enter selects; Escape closes
Enter keeps radio focus when closeOnSelect=false
Host radio selection keeps the focused menu item mounted
limitations: Checkbox state, directional variants, pointer travel and positioning
Keyboard context trigger gesture and focus restoration after pointer opening

testNames: audit/data-table: controlled sorting, filtering, pagination, selection and replacement
stateTransitions: new rows retain matching keyed selection
replacement clamps visible page and disables paging while retaining host pageIndex
nesting: Recipe renders native header/body, sort button, searchbox, checkboxes and pagination
notApplicable: Recipe supplies its own table structure
limitations: Page-size select uses the native change path via selectOption

testNames: audit/date-picker: single and range popup honor ISO changes and disabled state
stateTransitions: partial range → complete range → external empty range
notApplicable: Composite owns calendar slots

testNames: audit/dialog: controlled modal and keyboard dismissal
stateTransitions: Trigger opens, Escape closes, host writes true, explicit dismissal closes
keyboard: Enter trigger, Escape dismissal and trigger focus restoration
Tab wraps and skips disabled button
limitations: Outside interaction policies and visual animation

testNames: audit/drawer: controlled modal and keyboard dismissal
stateTransitions: Trigger opens, Escape closes, host writes true, explicit dismissal closes
Closing nested Drawer leaves outer open
nesting: Drawer.NestedRoot has independent controlled open state
keyboard: Enter trigger, Escape dismissal and trigger focus restoration
limitations: Outer Tab wrap outside the nested drawer scenario

testNames: audit/dropdown-menu: disabled items, radio State, and keyboard submenu
stateTransitions: Host writes radio selection; one keyboard choice changes State while menu stays open, then a second choice commits selection and closes
nesting: Group, RadioGroup and Sub with independent submenu content under portalled menu
keyboard: ArrowDown skips disabled item; e typeahead; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft enters/leaves submenu; Enter selects; Escape closes
Enter opens and focus returns to trigger
Enter keeps radio focus when closeOnSelect=false
Host radio selection keeps the focused menu item mounted
limitations: Checkbox state, directional variants, pointer travel and positioning

testNames: audit/empty: media presentation and recovery action
notApplicable: Empty itself has no native control

testNames: audit/field: fieldset association, validation errors and controlled input
keyboard: End and typing edit labeled input

testNames: audit/hover-card: hover, disabled, and focus lifecycle
stateTransitions: Disabled hover stays closed; host enables; hover/leave round trip; focus/Escape round trip
keyboard: Tab focuses trigger and opens; Escape closes while retaining focus
notApplicable: Information preview has no selected value
limitations: Timing thresholds, pointer transit over content and touch

testNames: audit/input: DOM input updates State and readonly preserves external text
keyboard: End and x while readonly; x reaches Core as keyDown
limitations: IME separately covered by ime-domain suite

testNames: audit/input-group: addon focus, keyboard clear and textarea round trips
nesting: Root → Addon/Text/Button with Input or Textarea
limitations: Other addon positions and control varieties

testNames: audit/input-otp: digits update derived slots and respect length and readonly
keyboard: Digit typing enforces maxlength and rejects letters

testNames: audit/item: variants, nested sections, separator and action
notApplicable: Item root here is presentational

testNames: audit/kbd: grouped native key labels update without becoming controls
stateTransitions: K → L updates native kbd text
notApplicable: kbd elements describe keys without focus or activation

testNames: audit/label: changes its native label association and focuses the target
stateTransitions: first → second changes associated input and subsequent focus target
notApplicable: Native label delegates control focus and is not a standalone keyboard stop

testNames: audit/marker: status role retains icon and content across variants
notApplicable: Status marker is display-only
limitations: Child snippet or alternative icon composition

testNames: audit/menubar: disabled items, radio State, and keyboard submenu
stateTransitions: Host writes radio selection; one keyboard choice changes State while menu stays open, then a second choice commits selection and closes
nesting: Group, RadioGroup and Sub with independent submenu content under portalled menu
keyboard: ArrowDown skips disabled item; e typeahead; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft enters/leaves submenu; Enter selects; Escape closes
Enter keeps radio focus when closeOnSelect=false
Host radio selection keeps the focused menu item mounted
limitations: Checkbox state, directional variants, pointer travel and positioning

testNames: audit/message: group retains avatar, header, bubble and footer when alignment changes
notApplicable: Message renders transcript content without its own controls
limitations: Other message media and nested actions

testNames: audit/message-scroller: keyboard jump returns a composed viewport to its end
stateTransitions: away → jump → end and button inactive
keyboard: Home moves away from the latest message
limitations: Prepending items and full streaming/unpinned behavior

testNames: audit/native-select: native change payload and external value preserve option grouping
stateTransitions: multiple [a,c] → user selection [b,c] persists through separate callback State update with first selected string b → external [a,b]
keyboard: Escape dispatches keyDown without changing selection
limitations: Headless browser cannot exercise OS-native dropdown keyboard selection
Multiple change payload is the first selected DOM string

testNames: audit/navigation-menu: controlled panels and keyboard links
stateTransitions: Host selects API and Docs; Enter opens Docs and Escape clears value
keyboard: Left/Right skips disabled trigger; Enter opens, Down enters content, Escape restores focus, Enter activates link

testNames: audit/pagination: page State and disabled boundaries
stateTransitions: Page 1 → 2 → 3 via controls; host resets page 1 and updates active flag
keyboard: Tab skips disabled Previous; Enter selects numbered page; Space activates Next
limitations: Loop, dynamic page lists and vertical orientation

testNames: audit/popover: nested overlay consumes Escape and restores focus
events: Child openChangeComplete true/false and parent false payload
stateTransitions: Host reopens parent, Close dismisses; closing child preserves parent
Immediate host child reversal settles closed and leaves parent open
keyboard: Space/Enter open; successive Escape closes child then parent and restores focus; Enter on Close

testNames: audit/progress: determinate, complete and indeterminate semantics
notApplicable: Progressbar is display-only

testNames: audit/questionnaire: required validation, controlled steps and keyboard submit
stateTransitions: format → detail → external format with preserved answer → detail → submit
nesting: Root → Item → Choices/Choice and Actions → Next/Submit
limitations: Skip/previous, reset, custom shortcuts and free-text input

testNames: audit/radio-group: keyboard selection skips disabled item and follows State
keyboard: ArrowRight selects next enabled radio and wraps

testNames: audit/range-calendar: completed ISO range and external clear update the grid
stateTransitions: external partial range → completed ISO range → external empty range
notApplicable: RangeCalendar parts require native scoped snippets

testNames: audit/resizable: keyboard emits layout proportions and clamps minimum pane size
stateTransitions: [45,55] → first pane grows → first pane returns within configured minimum
notApplicable: Layout is internally controlled
limitations: Drag separately covered by controls suite

testNames: audit/scroll-area: orientation changes axes and keyboard scrolls viewport
stateTransitions: vertical → both renders additional horizontal scrollbar
nesting: Root → generated viewport and scrollbars containing Card
notApplicable: No package-defined controlled scroll state

testNames: audit/select: portal options support keyboard selection and controlled open and value
audit/select: multiple choices emit arrays and external clear restores placeholder
stateTransitions: closed → open → busan/closed → external seoul/open → closed
nesting: Root → Trigger/Value and Portal → Content → Group → Item

testNames: audit/separator: decorative and semantic orientation changes
stateTransitions: decorative horizontal → semantic vertical with ARIA
notApplicable: Separator is display-only and non-focusable

testNames: audit/sheet: controlled modal and keyboard dismissal
stateTransitions: Trigger opens, Escape closes, host writes true, explicit dismissal closes
keyboard: Enter trigger, Escape dismissal and trigger focus restoration
Tab wraps and skips disabled button
limitations: Outside interaction policies and visual animation

testNames: audit/sidebar: desktop collapse, subnavigation, and keyboard shortcut
stateTransitions: Toggle/shortcut round trip and host collapses; nested link visibility follows open
nesting: Provider contains sidebar tree and trigger inside Inset; nested menu link
keyboard: Space on trigger; Ctrl+B shortcut; Enter activates nested link

testNames: audit/skeleton: conditional loading geometry and content replacement
stateTransitions: loading → visible report with placeholder removed
notApplicable: Skeleton is display-only

testNames: audit/slider: numeric and range thumbs emit stepped values within limits
keyboard: ArrowRight applies step and clamps maximum
notApplicable: Slider renders thumbs from value

testNames: audit/sonner: raw toaster stays separate from State notifications
events: Notifications.dismiss payload includes logical id/reason; host removal emits none
stateTransitions: Host removes a toast; keyboard dismissal; dispose/remount reconstructs current items; host toast survives recipe disposal
nesting: Raw and recipe toasters are siblings with isolated display
notApplicable: Raw Sonner display is driven by host toast API
limitations: Auto-dismiss timing, swipe and focus shortcut

testNames: audit/spinner: accessible SVG label in a disabled action
stateTransitions: busy → spinner removed and button enabled
notApplicable: Spinner itself is display-only
limitations: Other icon variants and animation timing

testNames: audit/switch: Space emits boolean and controlled disabled blocks changes
audit/table: native caption and section structure retain a selected row
nesting: Root → Caption, Header, Body, Footer, Row, Head, Cell
notApplicable: Table markup here has no interactive controls
limitations: Sticky headers and row action compositions

testNames: audit/tabs: arrows skip disabled triggers and State selects the matching panel
nesting: Root → List → Trigger; sibling matching Content
keyboard: ArrowRight selects next enabled tab and wraps

testNames: audit/textarea: DOM input updates State and readonly preserves external text
stateTransitions: Initial multiline → edited multiline → external external
keyboard: End and x while readonly; x reaches Core as keyDown
limitations: IME separately covered by ime-domain suite

testNames: audit/toggle: Space emits boolean and controlled disabled blocks changes
audit/toggle-group: single replacement and multiple selection use distinct payloads
keyboard: ArrowRight moves focus, Space selects multiple item

keyboard: Tab focuses trigger and opens; Escape closes while retaining focus
notApplicable: Information preview has no selected value

testNames: audit/trace: keyboard disclosure and line status transitions
limitations: Nested disclosures, links, and transition completion callback

testNames: audit/typography: semantic element replacement, slot precedence and safe text

notApplicable: Typography is display-only
